reason: Worker host reported overloaded; the first check was CPU and load, which looked fine. The real cause was OOM-kills of the Horizon container at its mem_limit, from too many horizon:work PHP processes. Lesson is class-level: triage memory and restart state before tuning CPU, and size processes against the container limit. Stage as a project skill for the distributed worker topology.

Aggregate rebuild jobs timed out at the 60s worker timeout while the DB was busy (22 on one run). The fix was per-job tries and backoff on an idempotent job, not a timeout change. The triage skill has no branch for timeouts without memory pressure.
